diff --git a/analytics/events.py b/analytics/events.py
--- a/analytics/events.py
+++ b/analytics/events.py
@@ -17,3 +17,4 @@ def publish(event):
-    broker.send(event)
+    sanitized = event.without("email", "ip_address")
+    broker.send(sanitized)

## Summary
Remove direct identifiers from analytics events before publication.
## Changes
- Strip email and IP address fields at the analytics boundary.
- Publish only the sanitized event payload.
## Testing
- Verified identifier removal while preserving allowed event fields.
## Risk
Medium — downstream analytics queries must not rely on the removed fields.

diff --git a/scheduler/cleanup.py b/scheduler/cleanup.py
--- a/scheduler/cleanup.py
+++ b/scheduler/cleanup.py
@@ -4,2 +4,4 @@ def run(now):
+    cutoff = now - timedelta(days=30)
+    audit_logs.delete_where(created_at__lt=cutoff)

## Summary
Enforce the 30-day retention policy for routine audit-log cleanup.
## Changes
- Calculate a cutoff from the scheduler's supplied time.
- Delete audit records older than that cutoff.
## Testing
- Tested records immediately before, at, and after the cutoff.
## Risk
High — permanently deletes retained audit data and requires policy confirmation.

diff --git a/mobile/deeplink.kt b/mobile/deeplink.kt
--- a/mobile/deeplink.kt
+++ b/mobile/deeplink.kt
@@ -9,3 +9,5 @@ fun open(uri: Uri) {
-    navigator.go(uri.path)
+    val route = allowedRoutes[uri.path] ?: return navigator.go("/home")
+    navigator.go(route)
 }

## Summary
Constrain mobile deep links to known application routes.
## Changes
- Resolve incoming paths through an allowlist.
- Send unknown paths to the home screen.
## Testing
- Exercised allowed, unknown, and empty deep-link paths.
## Risk
Low — unsupported links now fall back instead of navigating directly.
